baseline_definition.description: Standard gsplat rasterization() with default training path, no HiGS

semantics.training_state: FP32 masters (means, quats, scales, opacities, SH)

baseline_definition.backward: autograd through rasterization() (standard gsplat CUDA backward kernels)
baseline_definition.forward_state_saved: gsplat default: means2D, conics, colors, opacities, radii, geometry counts

description: HiGS hierarchical inference renderer with native differentiable backward

semantics.projection: Same fully_fused_projection as B (for visible subset)
semantics.alpha_compositing: Same front-to-back, but over HiGS macro-tile intersections
semantics.training_state: FP32 masters, packed FP16 scene buffers (culling path only)

native_backward.description: Custom CUDA kernels consuming forward-captured state
native_backward.state_binding: Forward-captured tensors (means2D, conics, colors_eval, opacities, per-tile sorted isects, render alphas, last ids, radii)
native_backward.gradient_scatter: Direct to FP32 master rows via visible_ids (no index_copy_)

protocol_matching.requirement: B and H must use identical: Gaussian state, cameras, resolution, loss, eps2d, render mode, SH degree, dtype, background, optimizer, LR, densification, pruning, camera ordering, seed
protocol_matching.verification: Benchmark harness ensures identical inputs; correctness gate verifies output parity
known_differences: H adds culling mask computation (discrete, no_grad) - documented as HiGS architectural feature
H native backward consumes different internal state layout - transparent to user API
H dynamic mode includes densify/prune with Adam-state sync - optional, not used in frozen benchmarks

exclusions.scope_note: This study isolates core Trainable HiGS architecture (hierarchical forward + native backward + dynamic topology). Optimization modules tested in separate studies.
